t.zh: 这条街首尾相连，围成一圈：第一家和最后一家也是邻居，不能都偷。
t.en: This street runs round in a ring: the first and the last house are neighbours too, and can’t both be robbed.

t.zh: 表有两层，甲和乙，每层都是<level-ref to="robber"></level-ref>那样的两行：这家没偷、这家偷了。两层各记什么由你决定；本格信息里有「是第一家」「是最后一家」和「是甲层」。
t.en: The table has two layers, A and B, each the two rows of <level-ref to="robber"></level-ref>: this house skipped, this house robbed. What each layer records is up to you; the cell’s facts include “is the first house”, “is the last house” and “is layer A”.

goal.zh: 不能偷相邻的两家，第一家和最后一家也算相邻。算出最多能偷多少钱。
goal.en: No two neighbouring houses, and the first and the last count as neighbours. Work out the most money you can steal.

how.zh: 答案是两层最后一列里最大的那一格。
how.en: The answer is the largest cell in the last column of either layer.

body.zh: 一圈拆不开，就分情况：甲层第一家不偷，剩下的是一条直街；乙层最后一家不偷，也是一条直街。两层取较大。
body.en: A ring won’t straighten out, so split it into cases: on layer A the first house is left alone and the rest is a straight street; on layer B the last is. Take the better of the two layers.

body.zh: 分情况也是多记一件事：这一件事，就是「我在哪种情况里」。
body.en: Splitting into cases is remembering one more thing too: which case you are in.

hints.zh: 首尾不能都偷，所以每种偷法至少放过其中一家。那两层可以各管一种情况吗？
hints.en: The ends can’t both be robbed, so every plan leaves at least one of them alone. Could each layer take one of those cases?

hints.zh: 哪一层、哪一家的「偷了」要拦下？「是甲层」可以当放行闸和拦截闸的条件。
hints.en: On which layer is “robbed” stopped, and at which house? “Is layer A” can be a gate’s condition.
